correctness.rationale: The matching \(\{a_i b_i\}\) proves the cover lower bound \(n\). Every maximum independent set is a canonical prefix-suffix cut, so every minimum vertex cover is one \(C_t\). For edges crossing the cut, the two zero coordinates identify both endpoints. For edges wholly on one side of the cut boundary, the unique selected endpoint plus a monotone distance-one threshold on the selected vertices recovers the other endpoint. The cases are exhaustive, and a direct checker confirms the complete basis family through \(n=9\).

value.rationale: The parameter was introduced to enforce simultaneous edge identification and edge coverage by a vertex cover. Half graphs are a canonical structured bipartite family, and the theorem shows that the two optimization requirements align exactly at every minimum cover. The complete basis classification and the contrast with ordinary edge metric dimension make the result a motivated structural statement rather than a routine scalar bound.
